title: Ed Magee: 'Financial gravity pulls freed resources toward next quarter’s number'
summary: The SEC's chief economist asked NACD Nashville what happens to the weeks AI frees up in a disclosure process, and argued for giving them back to the operators. Magee, a director, uses the book to name what happens by default instead.
attribution_title: COO and board member; NACD Nashville
blockquote: Eric Ries names the default outcome in Incorruptible. Financial gravity pulls freed resources toward next quarter’s number. The board decides whether they go there or into the long-term work that serves customers and shareholders.
